display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-28 Community of practice - Data-Driven Decision-Making in Energy – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-28 Community of practice - Data-Driven Decision-Making in Energy
executive_summary: Creates a European community of practice and innovation hubs for reusable energy-data tools, grid planning and simulation, and open methods and repositories. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive 100% for the coordination and support action under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 6 million, with around EUR 6 million expected per project. Opening 2027-08-04, full proposal deadline 2027-12-01 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 180–182, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to TSO Innovation Alliance. Grid operators are named in the scope. Annex B allows one or more eligible EU or associated-country legal entities to apply to a CSA, subject here to the European communications-network restrictions. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. The helper supplied both project dates from 1 January 2027 using its 36-month default.
